subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw require trusted explicit context snapshots for successful-turn overflow compaction and add persisted trigger reasons for auto-compactions from yielded subagent wake paths?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses runtime compaction policy, provider usage trust, persisted transcript metadata, and live subagent wake behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Guard And Attribute Compaction
options.body: Require explicit context snapshots or validated last-call usage for successful-turn overflow decisions, add a closed compaction trigger field, and prove the yielded subagent wake path live.

options.title: Usage-Only Repair
options.body: Fix only the inflated parent usage accounting or overflow guard first and defer persisted trigger metadata to a separate diagnostics change.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Recovery Policy
options.body: Move this under the broader repeated-compaction tracker and design one recovery policy for tool-loop, subagent, and low-context compaction cases.

recommendation.title: Guard And Attribute Compaction
recommendation.body: Require explicit context snapshots or validated last-call usage for successful-turn overflow decisions, add a closed compaction trigger field, and prove the yielded subagent wake path live.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans session-state, compaction safety, and product policy where history and prior review routing point closest to steipete.
